name: Prize: The Aether
description: Gravitite Ore enchanted at an Aether Altar.

pages.title: Enchanted Gravitite
pages.text: Gravitite Ore enchanted at an Aether **Altar**. It falls upward, which is exactly what a rocket wants.

pages.title: Where
pages.text: Gravitite Ore is a rare ore in Aether Holystone and needs an iron-tier pickaxe ([Zanite](item://aether:zanite_pickaxe) works). Mine it, then enchant it at an Altar fuelled with [Ambrosium](item://aether:ambrosium_shard). No boss needed; the Aether goes on forever.
